text:
sasha: heads-up — starting deploy to prod in ~10m for release v2026.3.4 (change window 01:00-02:00 UTC). This is a segmented rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Please watch latency + embed route errors on the release dashboard and call out anything odd. deploy-bot will post progress.

deploy-bot: rollout started (id: rl-20260304-77). stage=init -> will shift 5% traffic in 5m. changelist: feat/embeddings-cache-tweak + infra kv-gc-ramp.

matt: which dashboards should we prioritise? p50/p95/p99 token latency + embeds p95 + 5xx rate?

sasha: exactly — watch: https://internal.obsv/release/v2026.3.4 (latency, error-rate, kvcache evictions). Also open traces for embed-route and router.

aisha: observers are on it. I'll keep an eye on embed-route p95 and the p50 of serve-nx.

observability-bot: canary shift -> 5% applied at 1769998320 (rl-20260304-77). Synthetic probes pinging canary.

aisha: seeing a small bump on embed-route p95 (from 210ms -> 420ms) correlated with kvcache evictions spike. Not yet 5xx but p95 doubled for 30s.

noah: logs show repeated `kvcache: evict key=null user=unknown` and transient `oom: shard-allocator` entries around the same time. Posting snippet: ```[2026-03-04T01:05:12Z] kvcache evict user=svc-embed reason=mem-pressure
[2026-03-04T01:05:13Z] serve: embed-route p95=420ms p99=1.2s```

sasha: thanks. Matt/aisha — do we want to pause the ramp at 5% and investigate or continue to 25% and monitor tightly? We have a fallback plan to route embeds to fallback-quant model if needed.

matt: pause at 5% seems prudent. If evictions persist we should failover embedding route.

sasha: OK pausing ramp. deploy-bot: pause rollout (rl-20260304-77) — hold at 5%.

deploy-bot: rollout paused (requested by sasha) at 1769998375. No further traffic shifts scheduled.

aisha: filing a quick regression ticket with sample traces and prompt set now — will attach to the release notes.

ci-bot: alert -> prod-embeds-route error-rate anomaly (threshold: 0.5% -> current 1.8%). Pagerduty pinging #oncall.

noah: trying fallback routing now: `opsctl route update embed-route --target fallback-quant --weight 1.0 --dry-run=false`

ops-bot: executed `opsctl route update embed-route --target fallback-quant --weight 1.0`. routing updated at 1769998420.

aisha: after routing to fallback-quant, p95 dropped back to ~240ms and 5xx stabilized. Traces look cleaner.

sasha: good catch — leaving rollout paused while we document and ship a hotfix for kvcache tuning. We will not roll beyond 5% until patch is deployed and validated. Please add notes to release PR and update the changelog entry with the incident blurb.

matt: noted. I'll update release notes and open the follow-up: TRACK-emb-cache-2026.

aisha: adding the trace links and a short RCA draft to the ticket.

sasha: closing loop — keep this thread for final signoff. Once the kvcache patch is in and we see stable metrics for 10m at canary, we'll resume ramping. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: ci status: integration tests green for release branch. build/7789.

observability-bot: snapshot report (5m after failover): embed-route p95=230ms, 5xx=0.12%, kvcache evictions back to baseline.

noah: thumbs-up on smoke results. Planning hotfix rollout to canary in ~15m.

sasha: thanks all. final action items: (1) matt update release notes, (2) aisha attach traces, (3) noah prepare hotfix PR and canary, (4) ops keep fallback routing ready to revert. We'll reconvene in this thread for resume decision.
